# Requirement coverage and 2.0.1 self-audit

49 individual rows cover the 32 supplied topic pages and desktop-only guidance. Source checks are dated 2026-10-16. Static observations of the exact 2.0.1 target do not certify host behavior, policy compliance or publication. Human portal actions are outside this meta-tool. Blank templates remain valid before a target is loaded.

The original target archive and integrity-checked generated pack are retained beside this matrix. 2.0.1 has ten JSON scenario definitions and six native prompt folders; 2.1.0 adds the four missing native folders. Fixture references test preflight routing/applicability only unless the validation record says otherwise.
